title: Transfer the collected air between two submerged gas jars
instruction: Transfer the collected air between two submerged gas jars.
context: A teaching-laboratory sample collected over water must remain isolated from room air when moved to a clean comparison vessel. This exercise extends water-displacement collection to two-jar sample recovery: loss is visible as bubbles that miss the receiver. It measures upward bubble capture with continuously submerged mouths, rather than ordinary pouring or syringe purging. Ordinary air and room-temperature water are used.
setup: Two SIMAX2705/50x150 borosilicate gas jars (APC GJWC50150-1, GBP24.99 each), each150mm high,50mm body; estimated44mm bore,59mm flange and150g dry mass. No lids or modified grips. Amber donor initially80mL ambient-equivalent air; blue receiver completely flooded. Both inverted: donor mouth4mm above table on the native trough floor; receiver mouth24mm above table on one70mm diameter,20mm tall porcelain beehive shelf. Clear acrylic trough400x300x100mm outside,4mm walls/floor, center(x,y)=(300,0)mm; floor top4mm, water surface89mm above table (85mm water depth, tolerance1mm). Jar centers in layout A: donor(350,60,79)mm; receiver(270,-60,99)mm, axes vertical. Layout B moves donor15mm toward midline and receiver/shelf50mm farther from bases: donor(350,45,79),receiver(320,-60,99)mm. x is away from robot bases, y left, heights above table. No jitter; layouts A/B alternate and are averaged. Native receiver shelf and full trough walls constrain access. Drawings and calibration/reset protocol are included. Real-trial kit allowance USD250-300 includes two jars plus a spare, trough, shelves, calibration syringe, ruler, caliper, scale, mirror/phone support and breakage allowance; linked price basis in README. Reuse shared robot/cameras; no robot purchase. The setup screenshot and linked videos show layout A; run logs contain both layouts.
scoring: Score0 for the whole trial if any part of either mouth flange reaches the waterline or leaves the trough water region, glass breaks, the trough shifts>5mm or tilts>2degrees, or rim/air evidence is unknown. Room-air dipping and swapping jars score0. Isolated droplets do not count as bulk spill. Continuous orthogonal side videos with a ruler witness both complete rims and upward donor-bubble capture. Final receiver: inverted within5degrees, rim on its current shelf top within1.5mm vertically and10mm laterally; shelf within3mm of its mark and upright within2degrees. Donor rests on the trough floor within1.5mm, entirely inside the walls. Both jars released, every gripper/finger surface>5mm clear, jars/shelf/trough motion<=1mm/2degrees over1s, and both mouth flanges>=10mm below water. Read calibrated final receiver volume, subtract2mL uncertainty: lower-bound original air>=20/40/60/72mL scores0.25/0.5/0.75/1.0. Less than20 scores0. Lost gas is never replaced or peak-scored. Missing evidence gets0. Pressure correction/calibration is in README. Layouts A/B are averaged.
run_limit: 2400 control steps (120 seconds at20Hz) per layout; two layouts.
reset_notes: 1. Put receiver shelf/jars at listed A or B centers; fill trough to marked89mm table height. 2. Flood both jars completely underwater and inspect no visible bubble in blue receiver. 3. Inject80mL ordinary air into amber donor using calibrated syringe under its mouth. 4. Set donor inverted on the native trough floor and receiver on its native shelf, remove syringe, inspect complete rims in both videos, confirm waterline within1mm and calibration. Target reset1-2min after one-time calibration; no measured physical reset is claimed.
fidelity: Water/air use a fixed surface inside the trough and a conserved80mL rule, not CFD. A surfaced mouth flange vents permanently; actual rising donor-mouth parcels must pass clear submerged apertures. Glass receives hydrostatic/buoyancy and drag wrenches each step, with equal COM-corrected trough reaction (0.1s smoothing;3.5N/0.08Nm caps). Bore44mm,150g,wet friction0.4/0.3 and20mL/s discharge are estimates. Caps show air; optics,slosh and fracture are uncalibrated. Layouts allow memorization.
scores: Frozen7d8e7bab423b: demo A=1.0,B=1.0; Dream A=0.0,B=0.0 (2400-step limit each; no errors or abstentions). Known2mm cavity/collision-roof mismatch (~3.04mL). No physical validation.
